historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a professional services agreement with Theodore Osmundson and Associates, landscape architects, to design a children's play area in the unimproved part of Crocker-Amazon Playground next to McLaren Park, at the south end of La Grande Avenue.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved a professional services agreement with Esherick Hornsey Dodge and Davis, architects, to design a new community center building at Crocker-Amazon Playground, Geneva Avenue and Moscow Street, for a fee of $15,700; George Hornsey had shown the neighborhood the preliminary plans in May.

The principal baseball field at Crocker Amazon Playground, at Geneva and Moscow Streets and formerly Diamond No. 1, was dedicated on February 23, 1980 to Marino "Chick" Pieretti, for his long years teaching baseball to young players.

Mayor Dianne Feinstein was to break ground on April 12 for a wood-frame recreation center at Crocker-Amazon Playground, opposite the firehouse on Moscow Street, designed by Esherick, Hornsey, Dodge & Davis and paid for by the Mayor's Office of Community Development.
